audit.whatIsWrong: The page builds its whole 'green light' system around Scrap Shield's cooldown, but Scrap Shield is a flat 6 seconds — it is never a punish window. The genuine punishable state, Overheat, is never mentioned. The Equalizer's retreat-cutting terrain is also absent.
audit.why: Junkyard Titan: at 100% Heat Rumble Overheats and cannot cast spells for the lockout — that is the only reliable no-answer window in this lane. The Equalizer creates a wall of flames that damages and slows; Ziggs has no dash, so Satchel Charge (self-knockback) and Flash are the only ways through it.
audit.corrected: Scrap Shield is only a 6-second cooldown, so it is never your window — Overheat is. The Equalizer is the retreat-cutter: hold Satchel and Flash for the wall, not for damage. Range facts: Q 850 vs Flamespitter 600 (cone), Electro Harpoon 850 — answer harpoons at your own range, never inside the cone.
sources: kits: rumble P Overheat text, W cd 6, Q range 600, E range 850, R terrain flag
